payload.reason: The evidence indicates that NCEL demonstrates superior performance compared to various baseline methods, achieving significant improvements in linking precision and generalization ability across multiple datasets.

claims.text: NCEL achieves an average gain of 2% on Micro F1 and 3% on Macro F1, outperforming various baselines.
NCEL consistently outperforms other models in both easy and hard datasets, demonstrating its effectiveness in collective entity linking.
Trained on Wikipedia hyperlinks, NCEL outperforms state-of-the-art collective methods across five different datasets.
